mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated policy rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 300, it signals persistent inflation that triggers equity market sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and 5d returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint conditions of labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4%) and strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 650000) indicate an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4 and RSAFS > 650000, or the interaction effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and rising > 0.5% in last 3 months), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy-driven risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 AND FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.5% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and >0.5% increase in last 3 months), or the correlation is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong labor markets support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between PAYEMS and 20d returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a potential economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the correlation between INDPRO and 5d returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Joint conditions of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 650000) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicate a supply shock that drives inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 650000 and INDPRO < 100, or the interaction effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 650000), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as robust consumption supports corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and 60d returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
